title: After the earth moves
description: Follow one earthquake through a catalog of 34,091. Turn a section through the ground, remove the small events, and see what the pattern can—and cannot—tell us about a fault system.

title: The lives of startups
description: Follow all eight ventures in YC’s first batch, then change what counts as making it. A sale can be a loss; two startup origins can share one exit.
format: Linked life histories, a source-backed timeline, and a counting experiment

title: Kinship — You are inside the tree
description: Explore the complete OpenTree release from your own branch, then trace two organisms to their exact shared ancestor. Discover why a mushroom is closer kin to you than an oak.
format: Interactive tree-of-life atlas · 2.39 million terminal taxa
note: Complete OpenTree 16.1; evidence and unresolved junctions kept visible. About 34 MB.

title: Lifetimes — The company we keep
description: Begin at one couple’s table, then explore decades of Harvard research on early warmth, relationship quality, and everyday happiness.
format: Interactive visual essay · life timeline, cohort counts, model explorer

title: The Shape of War — A Visual Military History
description: Explore five millennia with detailed 3D equipment, 48 close-up views, and animated battle diagrams. Follow 49 battles from setup to outcome, and revisit any chapter.
note: Left / right arrow keys · 48 equipment close-ups · historical sources included

title: Solar Atlas — Space, at its actual scale
description: Fly between worlds in a Three.js solar system with true physical sizes and distances, 460 cataloged moons, 39,032 small bodies, orbit lines, saved checkpoints and reversible time.
note: 2026 trajectories; coverage and approximation limits documented in the atlas.

title: Groundwork — From Ground to Home
description: Watch a house grow from survey stakes to a finished home. Explore the structure, peel away walls, separate the floors, and trace the hidden paths of water, air, electricity and structural loads.

title: The Human Atlas
description: Explore changing territories on a globe, follow historical lives, and travel through 5,024 years with illustrated stories, world events, and regional eras.
note: 3000 BCE–2024 CE · territories, terrain, and a zoomable timeline

title: Automade — From Coil to Car
description: Follow one car through an animated 3D factory: stamping, welding, painting, powertrain, assembly and testing. Compare electric and combustion cars, then take the result apart.

title: Bow legs, in motion
description: Watch a 3D walking cycle, explore potential loading hotspots, and follow the knee-force diagram. Learn why strengthening can help with animated exercises and illustrated treatment options.
note: Educational anatomy; not an individual diagnosis.

title: Small Worlds
description: Seven little games about a complicated world. Make a choice, watch what happens, then change the rules and try again.

title: The Café That Was Too Efficient
description: Run a tiny café. Make every minute count. See who ends up waiting.

title: The Shortcut That Broke the City
description: Every driver takes the faster option. Everyone gets a slower commute.

title: Everyone Says It’s True
description: Eight confident people. Trace their evidence, then try the lesson in everyday life.

title: Good Robot, Bad Instructions
description: An eager little robot. A reasonable reward. A very unreasonable result.

title: Who Actually Won?
description: One village. Three snacks. The same votes. Three different winners.

title: The Last Fish
description: Four boats share a lake. How much of tomorrow will you catch today?

title: The Average That Lied
description: Two repair shops. One misleading leaderboard. Change the mix and discover Simpson’s paradox.

title: The jagged AI frontier
description: One connected graph across models, chips, energy, data centers, economics and deployment. Follow the constraints that make progress uneven.

title: Inside inference
description: Build an understanding of inference through 15 guided visual arguments: attention, prefill, KV caches, quantization, parallelism and production serving. Work the numbers and test your intuition.

title: GPUs & TPUs
description: An interactive architecture atlas: how accelerators move data, multiply matrices and turn silicon into useful throughput.

title: Physical AI
description: From motion to silicon: world models, control loops and on-device inference meet the constraints of the physical world.

title: LLM inference, one token at a time
description: Explore the mechanics and tradeoffs behind serving a language model, from memory traffic to generation speed.

title: OS under glass
description: One explorable machine connects processes, virtual memory, scheduling, files, networking and boot.

title: Kubernetes
description: Explore how a cluster turns a desired state into running workloads, and what happens when the real world diverges.

title: How Lean checks a proof
description: Follow a mathematical claim from proof steps to a small trusted kernel, with worked examples and numerical experiments.

title: The Selfish Gene
description: Revisit the logic of gene-centered evolution and the examples that connect cooperation, kinship and natural selection.
